title_as_printed: Experimental Contents of Water and Dew-Point Temperatures and Pressures for Gas 1 + Water and for Gas 2 + Water
pressure_note: dew-point pressure measured with a pressure transmitter (max error 0.1%) at the chilled-mirror instrument inlet; absolute/gauge not stated

value.what: x_water = experimental mean value of water mole fraction of the gas mixture, printed only in the block label; the dew T,P pair is the measured quantity

composition.other_species: Gas 1 = propane 5(+-1)% + CO2 95(+-1)%; Gas 2 = n-butane 1(+-1)% + CO2 99(+-1)% (prepared by weight, basis % not stated);

conversion_needs: P printed in units of 10^5 Pa (= bar)
block label gives water mole fraction with a thin space as digit separator: 0.001 08 = 0.00108
gas mixtures: dry-gas composition quoted in Table 1 by supplier only
notes: Block layout printed as three side-by-side T/P column pairs per block; stacked left pair first, then middle, then right, as in the printed reading order down each column. Dew points of 247-290 K and 1.1-21.8 bar; authors note some may lie in solid-vapor (hydrate/ice) metastable region. Row indices 0-based over all rows after header incl. label rows.
